title: Preparation with N-ACETYLCYSTEINE plus SIMETHICONE prior to a high-quality upper gastrointestinal endoscopy to improve gastric mucosal visibility and increase diagnostic accuracy. GASTROprep
official: Preparation with N-ACETYLCYSTEINE plus SIMETHICONE prior to a high-quality upper gastrointestinal endoscopy to improve gastric mucosal visibility and increase diagnostic accuracy. GASTROprep
summary: Main objective: Evaluate whether premedication with N-acetylcysteine + simethicone, administered 30–60 minutes before EDAACC, improves the visibility and cleanliness of the gastric mucosa, as measured using the Barcelona scale.

interventions.name: acetilcisteína cinfa 200 mg polvo para solución oral EFG

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. adults (≥18 years) capable of providing informed consent
2. Outpatients scheduled to undergo an upper gastrointestinal endoscopy  with chromoendoscopy in the Digestive Endoscopy Unit of the participating hospitals.
Exclusion criteria:
1. age under 18 years
2. pregnancy
3. patients with high anesthetic risk (ASA IV)
4. previous gastric surgery that alters the anatomy
5. planned therapeutic procedures
6. need for therapeutic endoscopy or an urgent procedure
7. allergy or contraindication to the proposed preparation
8. failure to comply with the fasting requirements or the assigned preparation.
